business_summary: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, leasing, sale, and servicing of tunnel boring machines, rail transit equipment, and specialized equipment in China and internationally. The company offers tunnel boring machines, drilling and blasting construction equipment, rail track and transit systems, agricultural machines, green building materials construction equipment, new construction materials, and mine construction equipment. China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Changsha, China. The company operates as a subsidiary of China Railway Construction Corporation Limited.
business_summary_ko: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited는 중국 및 국제적으로 터널 굴착 기계, 철도 운송 장비 및 특수 장비의 연구, 설계, 개발, 제조, 임대, 판매 및 서비스에 종사합니다. 이 회사는 터널 굴착 기계, 드릴링 및 발파 건설 장비, 철도 선로 및 운송 시스템, 농업 기계, 친환경 건축 자재 건설 장비, 새로운 건설 자재 및 광산 건설 장비를 제공합니다. 중국철도건설중공업공사(China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited)는 2006년에 설립되었으며 중국 창사에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 이 회사는 China Railway Construction Corporation Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
